raw_findings.issue: SQL query built with string formatting/concatenation
raw_findings.evidence: cursor.execute("SELECT id, username, name, surname FROM users WHERE id=" + params["id"])
raw_findings.fix: Use parameterized queries, e.g., cursor.execute("SELECT id, username, name, surname FROM users WHERE id=?", (params["id"],))

raw_findings.issue: Unsafe deserialization using pickle on untrusted user input
raw_findings.fix: Avoid using pickle for untrusted input; use safer serialization formats such as JSON.

raw_findings.issue: Command injection via subprocess with shell=True
raw_findings.evidence: content = subprocess.run("nslookup " + params["domain"], shell=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, errors="replace").stdout
raw_findings.fix: Avoid shell=True and pass arguments as a list to subprocess.run.

raw_findings.issue: Arbitrary code execution using exec() on user-controlled input
raw_findings.fix: Remove or securely restrict the execution of dynamic code.

raw_findings.issue: SQL query built with string formatting
raw_findings.evidence: found = bool(cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username='" + re.sub(r"[^\w]", "", params.get("username", "")) + "' AND password='" + params.get("password", "") + "'").fetchall())

architecture.summary: Damn Small Vulnerable Web (DSVW) is a deliberately vulnerable web application written in under 100 lines of Python code for educational and testing purposes. It supports a wide range of common web application vulnerabilities and attacks, and includes a comprehensive local regression and test suite.

modules.name: dsvw.py
modules.purpose: Main server script implementing the vulnerable web application logic in under 100 lines of code.

modules.name: tests/harness.py
modules.purpose: Test harness used for running automated regression and exploitability tests against the DSVW server.

modules.name: tests/test_cases.py
modules.purpose: Defines specific attack vectors and test cases corresponding to the vulnerabilities present in DSVW.

modules.name: tests/fixture.py
modules.purpose: Provides local HTTP fixtures to enable self-contained testing without requiring internet access.
